ImageDescription.value: Biology and wildlife of Ukraine: an adult earthworm (Lumbricidae family) on wet asphalt after a heavy rain shower. A light thickening — the clitellum — is clearly visible on the segmented body, indicating the maturity of the hermaphrodite individual. Garden in Dnipro city. Author of the "Baby-Bear Club" project (educational materials for children from 0 to 7).
